pyupgrade incorrect output
before
```python
expectedResult = (
    ":example.com \u0442\u0435\u0441\u0442 " "\u043d\u0438\u043a\r\n"
).encode("utf-8")
```

expected
```python
b':example.com \xd1\x82\xd0\xb5\xd1\x81\xd1\x82 \xd0\xbd\xd0\xb8\xd0\xba\r\n'
```

or maybe this?
```python
':example.com тест ник\r\n'.encode()
```

actual
```python
expectedResult = ().encode("utf-8")
```
